sources.title: Latin NCAP
sources.facts_supported: Updated assessment protocol effective 1 Jan 2026 to Dec 2029: stricter side/pole tests; NEW adult-occupant assessment for the REAR seat (rear-belt pretensioners/load-limiters) and rear whiplash; weakest of the four assessment boxes determines total stars; published results carry test year and protocol and have time-limited advertising use. Does not itself mandate a specific seat count.

sources.facts_supported: New vehicles need LCM (Licencia para Configuracion de Modelo) and LCA to circulate; for manufacturer/importer via TAD; WP.29 whole-vehicle certification can use CVHE; autos/camionetas with a Brazil CAT can obtain LCM under the Mutual Recognition Agreement (ARM); multistage vehicles need Constancia Tecnica (Decree 196/2025); fees listed as of 01/08/2026.

sources.title: Brazil - Lei no 9.503 Codigo de Transito Brasileiro (Presidencia da Republica)
sources.organization: Brazil - Lei no 9.503 Codigo de Transito Brasileiro (Presidencia da Republica)
sources.facts_supported: Art.96 vehicle classification: CAMINHONETE = cargo vehicle with gross vehicle weight up to 3,500 kg; CAMIONETA = mixed vehicle carrying passengers and cargo in the same compartment; veiculo de carga may carry two passengers besides driver; LOTACAO = max useful load (kg for cargo / number of persons for passengers); CNH categories by seats/GVW; Art.99 weight/dimension limits set by CONTRAN; Art.109 cargo in passenger vehicles only per CONTRAN norms. Amended by Lei 14.440/2022 and 14.599/2023.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: Latin NCAP protocol 2026-2029 (effective 1 Jan 2026) adds rear-seat adult-occupant assessment incl rear-belt pretensioners/load-limiters and rear whiplash, and the weakest assessment box sets total stars - evidence that third-row/restraint content is assessed, but it does not mandate a seat count.
claim_source_matrix.EXACT_SUPPORT: Latin NCAP protocol news, full text.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: Argentina requires LCM (+LCA) for a new model to circulate; WP.29 whole-vehicle certification routes via CVHE and a Brazil CAT routes via ARM - destination model approval for the exact derivative.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: Brazil defines LOTACAO (number of persons for passenger vehicles / kg for cargo) and sets weight limits via CONTRAN - the legal basis for full-load passenger+luggage payload checks.

A '7 seats' badge is not proof of carrying planned adults+luggage within permitted load; require exact-derivative seating/restraint and OEM payload data (methodology).
